introHtml: BIC mechanical pencils offer the reliability and consistent performance that you expect from a trusted brand. When you choose custom BIC mechanical pencils for your business, you get a writing instrument that employees and clients will actually use. Ideal for trade shows, welcome kits, or everyday office use, these pencils can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving. The classic BIC design ensures broad appeal, while your custom imprint keeps your brand top of mind.
